name: Centum Scrub Intake Module
description: Standardizes the 4 intake files (Scrub BOM, QuoteWin, ERP, Costing Sheet) into DuckDB input tables for one RFQ version.

tools.name: centum_intake__standardize_scrub_bom
tools.description: Parse and standardize the Scrub BOM Excel file into DuckDB scrub_bom_items table. HITL gate: halts to collect QuoteWin/Costing Sheet if not yet uploaded.

tools.name: centum_intake__standardize_quote_win
tools.description: Parse and standardize the QuoteWin Excel file into DuckDB quote_win table.

tools.name: centum_intake__standardize_erp
tools.description: Parse and standardize the ERP master data extract into DuckDB erp table.

tools.name: centum_intake__standardize_costing_sheet
tools.description: Parse and standardize the Costing Sheet Excel file into DuckDB costing_sheet table.
